observations.behavior: Adds a column to a temporary person identity table.
observations.code_quote: ALTER TABLE personhog_person_tmp ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_user_id INTEGER;
observations.posthog_connection: Supports identity mirroring by including the is_user_id column, which identity queries expect, while the table remains temporary and not written to by personhog.
